summary: Live Oak Acquisition Corp. V filed an 8-K disclosing a second amendment to its merger agreement with Teamshares Inc., originally dated November 14, 2025 and previously amended April 1, 2026. The amendment modifies terms of the business combination whereby Live Oak, a SPAC, will combine with Teamshares. No specific financial terms, premium, or board recommendation are stated. The transaction remains subject to regulatory and shareholder approvals. Watch for further filings disclosing pricing, shareholder vote, and risk-arb spread relative to trust value.
